profiles.operator_summary: Primary touchscreen/display target. Automated source/API coverage exists; physical audio, speaker, display, SD media, and OTA field validation are still required before release.

manual: Capture at least one wake-to-STT turn from the built firmware and confirm audio chunks reach `/api/voice/ws` with the expected endpoint id.
Confirm no duplicated post-TTS capture during the firmware cooldown window.
Say the configured wake word from idle and confirm the endpoint enters listening/capturing.
Confirm a below-threshold wake attempt is reported without starting STT.
Complete a voice turn and confirm audible playback starts, finishes, and emits playback completion telemetry.
Replay a cached TTS artifact from the UI/API and confirm endpoint playback.
Verify idle, listening, thinking, replying, error, and OTA display states on the panel.
Verify media-delivered UI assets render from the SD card after reboot.
Run an OTA push for the `esp_box_3` artifact and confirm the endpoint returns on the same id.
Deliver picture, sprite, sound, and manifest assets to SD media and verify inventory reports them after reconnect.
Send backend mute, unmute, and volume commands and confirm firmware state/telemetry changes.
Use local controls, if present on the device build, and confirm they do not conflict with backend commands.
Restart the backend during idle and active voice states and confirm the endpoint reconnects using the configured backoff.
Power-cycle the endpoint and confirm heartbeat, capabilities, and firmware version return in the operator UI.

profiles.operator_summary: Audio/LED-ring target with no display and NVS-only media storage. Automated source coverage exists for the PE board profile; physical XMOS audio, codec playback, LED ring, controls, and OTA field validation are still required before release.

manual: Capture a wake-to-STT turn from the PE microphone and confirm speech reaches the backend.
Confirm micro-VAD does not stream while the hardware mute is active.
Say the configured wake word and confirm the LED ring enters the wake/listening pattern.
Press the center button and confirm it starts a button wake session.
Complete a voice turn and confirm codec output at the PE speaker sample rate.
Confirm the wake accepted ding plays without replacing the following TTS response.
Confirm boot, idle, listening, capturing, thinking, replying, completed, muted, disconnected, and OTA ring patterns.
Confirm no panel display is expected for this profile and the operator UI labels the profile accordingly.
Run an OTA push for the `ha_voice_pe` artifact and confirm the endpoint returns on the same id.
Confirm media/SD features are reported as unsupported or NVS-only rather than silently failing.
Toggle hardware mute and confirm microphone streaming stops and LED state changes.
Rotate volume and color controls, including center-held color selection, and confirm they do not trigger voice sessions.
Restart the backend during idle and active voice states and confirm the PE reconnects using the configured backoff.
Power-cycle the PE and confirm heartbeat, capabilities, profile, and firmware version return in the operator UI.

unsupported_profiles.operator_behavior: Profiles not listed here are unvalidated. `firmware/build.sh` must reject unsupported `HEXE_BOARD_PROFILE` values before build or OTA push.
